priorities.title: Owner / proxy / sealing — review authority
priorities.guidance: The observed authority, proxy implementation or sealing flag changed. Independently verify who controls it and when it changed.

priorities.title: Counters / observations — track activity
priorities.guidance: The recorded counter or identity value changed. This alone does not imply a security issue.

provenance: Deterministic review ordering of client-supplied (NOT independently authenticated) before/after X Layer values. Not a security finding, verified transaction, security score, audit, or on-chain attestation.
